title: wmux settings
description: Settings for wmux.json and the shared cmux.json. Keys use cmux names; wmux-only keys live under "wmux".

$schema.description: Schema URL for editor completion (the wmux or the cmux schema).

schemaVersion.description: Config format version; newer versions are read best effort.

packs.description: Pack files or directories applied beneath this file (values set here win). Relative entries start from this file's directory. A directory resolves to wmux.pack.json, then cmux.pack.json.

autosave.title: Save the session automatically
autosave.description: Save the session layout every 8 seconds when it changed, and fully on quit, on closing the last window and on logoff or shutdown. Off: the session file is not updated (the last saved session is still restored).

restoreOnLaunch.title: Restore the previous session on launch
restoreOnLaunch.description: Reopen the windows, workspaces, splits and tabs of the last session when wmux starts (the terminals start again in their working directories). WMUX_DISABLE_SESSION_RESTORE or CMUX_DISABLE_SESSION_RESTORE, or launching wmux with a path, URL or command, skips the restore once.
